public_rationale: The joint conditions are unverified. OpenAI reported resuming frontier training on October 1 after a temporary safety pause. DeepSeek's earlier distillation work challenges any assumption that only Anthropic and OpenAI can supply teachers, but it does not settle the conditional post-bubble forecast. The separate judgment that training has no justification lacks a stated objective test.
limitations: A reading that treats the teacher clause as independent of the bubble condition would need a separate assessment.

our_interpretation: The empirical forecast concerns the availability of suitable teacher models after a collapse in AI investment and cessation of relevant training by Anthropic and OpenAI.
Both conditions are retained from the sentence and its context; a short safety pause alone does not establish the post-bubble scenario.
Suitable teachers may include existing models or models from other developers.
No justification is an evaluative judgment without a stated financial or technical test. Continued investment alone would not prove that judgment wrong.
criteria.support_condition: Following the specified conditions, suitable teacher models become unavailable and no alternative source can supply them. Any claim about economic justification would additionally require a defined investment-return criterion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the specified conditions occur, existing models or models produced without the stipulated Anthropic and OpenAI training remain suitable and available for successful distillation.
